Description

is one of the Core Lines in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division, and runs to the north of Downtown. The line starts from Peckern North, and passes through West Metropolis Archipelago, the Threeler area of Sava, before reaching Downtown. Afterwards, it passes through Katadelphia, Flask, Youngsters and Glacier, before reaching Ingress. Future development will see it extending to Winsol and Asylum.

This route is represented by Dark Blue Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 6.

Currently, this route is 49.62 km long, with a total of 31 stations.

Line Charcteristics

<!--

  • One of the six initially planned lines of NR Los Sengas Division.
  • "Arcgo" is the abbreviation of "Archipelago".
  • Mainly serves areas to the north of Downtown.
  • Has an emergency stop at Ponsand Island.
  • Except for North Coast Road Station, all stations along this line uses Platform Screen Doors.
  • This line adopts a fully enclosed design, including in overground sections.

Fun Facts

  • Despite being named , this line is the last Core Line to reach West Metropolis Archipelago (WMA) in Season 1. Before reached the West Metropolis Archipelago, , and have already completed their routes across West Metropolis Archipelago.</ref>
  • Initial plans of Nazca Railway through the WMA features Ponsand, Ponrest, Belt Island, Elevate Island and Inthree Island before reaching Eagle Island, which is part of the existing route. However, Nazca Ferry (NFC) opposed to this proposal due to conflicts in shipping routes. As a result, Nazca Railway reduced the number of islands stopped by this line, and the section between Ponsand and Elevate Island was diverted to Star Island to gain approval from NFC.
  • Belt Island Station was one of the planned stations of this line, but was rejected by NFC. This station instead served in 2016. Later expanded to interchange with .</ref>
  • Elevate Island Station was one of the planned stations of this line, but was rejected by NFC. This station instead served in 2017.
  • Ponrest Station was one of the planned stations of this line, but was rejected by NFC. This station instead served in 2019.
  • Ponsand Island featured a set of emergency platforms, but trains do not stop there. (Originally, plans were set to have a station there, but due to development from NFC, this plan was aborted.)
  • Originally, Mayler Airport Station was built between Jayler Station and Mayler Station, but due to privatisation of Mayler Airport, that station was never put in use and was later demolished when was established.
  • Origin Station was originally meant to be built after S1E4, but due to the fact that this section shares tracks wtih , this line was prematurely established, and before the establishment of , a set of hollow walls was built behind the side platforms of this line to hide the reserved space for that line. Once is established, the walls are demolished and the side platforms become island platforms.
  • A set of sidings is placed between Fosina Station and High Parallel Station.
  • Since the establishment of this line, all stations and sections involved are enclosed even when they are elevated. As a result, some players refer to this phenomenon, as well as the Railway founder, as "The Enclosed Curse of Arcgo Line".
  • Will extend to Fairlight Station<!--, , Magma Line Station--> and Arctic Sea Station in the future.

'''Arcgo West Island''' is an artificial island located outside the east coast of Peckern North. While Arcgo West Isle originally belonged to West Metropolis Archipelago, repeated island reclamation has caused development on this island, as well as the Arcgo West Isle, to be connected to Peckern North. Hence, both the island and the isle now belongs to Peckern North.
